context: Two teens form a study group at the library
purpose: Teach: 英会話/学力/用紙/習得/用いる/仮定/抽象/率直

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ陸、来週の学力テストやばくない?一緒に勉強しようよ。
lines.en: Hey Riku, isn't next week's academic ability test brutal? Let's study together.
lines.style: Casual teen invitation, friendly and slightly hesitant tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいよ。英会話の宿題も出てるし、図書館行こう。
lines.en: Sure. We've got English conversation homework too, let's go to the library.
lines.style: Relaxed teen agreement, practical and easygoing male voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう。実はさ、率直に言うと英語が全然できなくて、ちょっと焦ってるんだ。
lines.en: Thanks. Honestly, frankly speaking I can't do English at all, I'm kind of panicking.
lines.style: Vulnerable teen confession, voice drops with embarrassment slightly

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。うちの先生の教え方、抽象的すぎてさ、何覚えればいいか分かんないよね。
lines.en: I get it. Our teacher's teaching style is too abstract, you can't tell what to memorize.
lines.style: Sympathetic teen complaint, mild frustration with school vibes

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ね。じゃあさ、仮定の話だけど、出そうな単語を百個書き出して、この用紙に半分ずつ分けない?
lines.en: Right? So, hypothetically, what if we list a hundred likely words and split them on this sheet?
lines.style: Energetic teen proposing a plan, voice brightens with idea

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おー、それいいね。でも一日五十個って、きつくない?
lines.en: Oh, that's good. But fifty a day, isn't that brutal?
lines.style: Teen pushback with light humor, slightly whining tone here

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 確かに多いね。でも、言語習得には反復が一番って、塾の先生も言ってたよ。
lines.en: True, that's a lot. But for language acquisition, repetition is best — my cram school teacher said so.
lines.style: Encouraging teen optimism, trying to motivate her friend gently

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: へえ、その方法を用いるってわけね。先生っぽい言い方じゃん。
lines.en: Huh, so we're going to employ that method. You sound like a teacher.
lines.style: Teasing teen retort, playful imitation of formal speech

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うるさいなあ。とにかく一週間頑張ろう、絶対点数上がるから。
lines.en: Oh shush. Anyway, let's grind for a week, our scores will totally go up.
lines.style: Mock-annoyed teen pushing back with determined cheer

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: よし、やる。終わったらカラオケな、約束だぞ。
lines.en: Alright, I'm in. We're going to karaoke after, that's a promise.
lines.style: Determined teen agreement with playful reward demand attached
